lead_raw_text:
The structure of CeMnSi₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms (Ce₄Mn₄Si₈) distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for Ce, Mn, and Si centers, each with four geometric neighbors, and the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Ce and Mn tetrahedra, corner- and edge-sharing between Ce and Si tetrahedra, and edge-sharing between Si tetrahedra.
